parameters.content:
### Requeue one definitively rejected QA intent

Run manually only after the read-only account job audit is reviewed. Execution794 received HTTP429 concurrent_limit_exceeded,current3/limit3 from middleware that returns before job creation. No accepted ID was captured.

This fixture audits recent jobs again, checks exactly D51 QA row1/source-r1 and every frozen request digest, then updates only status and last_error. A matching job, changed content, duplicate/missing row or incomplete time coverage stops it. It does not render, modify source Sheets, change counters or bypass plan limits. Source/other ledger rows remain intact. A second run stops because the intent is no longer submitting.
